never_quit.description: Whether the service always stays in memory running or quits when the last client disconnects.

connector_name.description: IPC connector name used for communication.

log_level.description: Logging level (0=disabled, 7=default, 8=all, or comma-separated list of levels).

netf_list.description: Comma-separated list of interface names, SSIDs, or IP addresses for network filtering.
